name: sj-svalbard-tax-residence
description: Determine Svalbard individual and company tax residence and ordinary cross-border scope for 2026. Covers permanent residence from the beginning of a twelve-month stay, temporary work and business, the conditional five-year newcomer limitation, rolling departure days, medical absence, local property and mainland or foreign income allocation. Explains mainland exemption for Svalbard-taxed items, treaty exclusion, foreign dividend withholding and associated filing/payment duties. Flags mainland exit tax when moving to Svalbard and separates it from departure from Svalbard. Two calculations test nonresident withholding and the foreign-capital credit ceiling. Use for Svalbard residence, moving, nonresidents, cross-border tax and distributions. Jan Mayen is excluded; specialist relief and exit computations remain limited. This source-cited draft awaits professional review.
